with_kaj7.speaker: kaj7
with_kaj7.text: This is it. It is not a maker. It is many. It is saying my name in a voice that has never had a mouth. It is asking me to come home.

choices.text: You are home. We're standing right here.

stay.speaker: kaj7
stay.text: Then I will keep listening, and you will keep standing there. That is an arrangement I can hold.

cut.speaker: kaj7
cut.text: Cut. It is quieter. I do not know if quieter is better. I will find out with you.

alone.speaker: player
alone.text: A relay, still live, singing on a band nobody uses. It sounds like many voices agreeing. Somewhere a shepherd unit is hearing this.

dead.speaker: player
dead.text: Kaj-7 never got to hear this. The relay says its name anyway.
